description: This file contains common utility functions and variables for managing Kubernetes clusters, including kubeconfig creation, certificate generation, release artifact handling, and command execution wrappers.

methods.name: create-kubeconfig
methods.description: Generates kubeconfig data for a cluster, setting up cluster, user, and context configurations.

methods.name: clear-kubeconfig
methods.description: Removes kubeconfig data for a specified context.

methods.name: get-kubeconfig-basicauth
methods.description: Retrieves username and password for the current kubeconfig context.

methods.name: get-kubeconfig-user-basicauth
methods.description: Sets KUBE_USER and KUBE_PASSWORD from a specified kubeconfig section.

methods.name: gen-kube-basicauth
methods.description: Generates a random username and password for basic auth.

methods.name: get-kubeconfig-bearertoken
methods.description: Retrieves bearer token for the current kubeconfig context.

methods.name: load-or-gen-kube-basicauth
methods.description: Loads existing or generates new basic auth credentials.

methods.name: set_binary_version
methods.description: Sets KUBE_VERSION based on input, fetching from URL if needed.

methods.name: find-tar
methods.description: Searches for a specified tarball in known locations.

methods.name: find-release-tars
methods.description: Verifies presence of release tarballs needed for Kubernetes components.

methods.name: generate-etcd-cert
methods.description: Generates etcd service certificates using cfssl.

methods.name: verify-kube-binaries
methods.description: Checks for required kubectl binary, downloads if missing.

methods.name: verify-release-tars
methods.description: Checks for release artifacts, downloads if missing.

methods.name: pushd
methods.description: Wrapper for pushd that suppresses output.

methods.name: popd
methods.description: Wrapper for popd that suppresses output.
